dataset: option40 - 1080d IV tenor + IV term structure + composite
hypothesis: 1080d IV skew (19/18 users - least popular) should have lower prod_corr than 360d (25/20 users, prod_corr=0.7529). IV term structure (long-short IV) is a completely different signal that might have much lower prod_corr.

key_findings: 1080d IV skew (3qe8JY0Z) passes RA: sh1.93/fit1.65/subU0.85/2Y2.02 - decent but weaker than 360d (sh2.03)
Composite 360d+1080d (Xg8dMwNz) passes RA: sh1.98/fit1.73/subU0.87/2Y2.15 - between 360d and 720d individually
IV term structure completely FAILED: sh0.47-1.02 - IV curve slope is not a predictive signal for returns
Reversed skew is exact mirror (sh-1.93) confirming signal symmetry
1080d prod_corr=0.7621 is NOT lower than 360d (0.7529) despite fewer users - signal type matters more than field popularity
analysis.conclusion: 360d @ SLOW_AND_FAST (0.7529) remains the BEST prod_corr. Changing tenor alone cannot push below 0.7. The IV skew signal is fundamentally correlated with production alphas regardless of tenor. Need a different signal type (IV mean) or different approach.
analysis.next_action: b98: IV mean signal test (completely different signal type, much less popular fields)
